headline: Anthropic signs $10B compute deal; Oregon weighs data-center pause
body: A quiet day. Anthropic signed a roughly $10 billion compute deal with Volta and confirmed a custom chip team, raising Capability Velocity and Power Concentration and lifting Enslaved God, Zookeeper and Descendants. Oregon Democrats proposed a three-year pause on large data centers, a small Tech Backlash signal. Horizon Balance slipped to -1.53.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.1, Zookeeper +0.1 and Descendants +0.1 all came from the Anthropic-Volta deal (+0.11, +0.09 and +0.07).
